test_title: PYST 89: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

I felt I am dying of weakness, / and have barely strength to write, / but it must be done if I die in the doing.

options.text: but it must be done if I die in the doing.
and have barely strength to write,
I felt I am dying of weakness,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**I felt I am dying**" is **incorrect** due to the** inconsistency in the tenses**.
 
• The past tense "**felt**" should be followed by the past continuous tense "**was dying**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I felt I was dying of weakness**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***I felt I was dying of weakness,** and have barely strength to write, but it must be done if I die in the doing.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "but it must be done if I die in the doing."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "and have barely strength to write,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct, although inserting "barely any" or "barely enough" would add clarity but isn’t
